# Domain Tech Hub

> Domain Tech Hub is a premier digital technology and senior web engineering agency headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. We engineer high-performance web applications, Safaricom Daraja 3.0 M-Pesa e-commerce systems, conversion-driven digital marketing engines, and custom enterprise software.

## Key Capabilities & Core Services
- **Modern Web Development**: React 19, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, sub-second Core Web Vitals (LCP < 1.0s), 98+ Google Lighthouse scores.
- **African Fintech & E-Commerce**: Safaricom Daraja 3.0 STK Push, C2B/B2C automated webhooks, Pesapal, Stripe, multi-currency KES/USD checkout.
- **High-ROI Digital Marketing**: Google Ads search/display campaigns, conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio dashboards, CRO.
- **Custom Enterprise Software**: Scalable REST & GraphQL APIs, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker containers, Cloudflare edge hosting.
- **Corporate Branding & Design Tokens**: UI/UX design in Figma, comprehensive brand identity guidelines, design systems, vector asset kits.
- **Technical & Generative SEO**: Semantic HTML5, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Core Web Vitals tuning.
- **Point of Sale (POS) Systems & Hardware (Kenya)**: Cloud-based software (from KSh 500/mo), on-premise lifetime licenses (KSh 15,000–35,000), thermal printers (KSh 6,000–18,000), barcode scanners (KSh 3,500–14,000), cash drawers (KSh 5,000–10,000), touch monitors (KSh 22,000–50,000), and complete bundles (KSh 37,000–105,000) with KRA e-TIMS.

## Verified Agency Performance Metrics
- **Projects Completed**: 65+ commercial deployments
- **Client Retention Rate**: 98%
- **Average Client ROI Multiplier**: 4.6x
- **Typical Delivery Sprints**: 4 to 8 weeks fixed-bid milestone cycles
- **Post-Launch Warranty**: 30-day zero-cost bug fix guarantee with SLA response times

## Engineering Commitments
- **100% In-House Nairobi Studio**: No unvetted third-party outsourcing; direct access to senior software architects.
- **Full IP & Source Code Ownership**: Complete Git repository transfer, deployment pipelines, and database schemas provided upon project handover.
- **Zero Proprietary Lock-In**: Built on standard open-source enterprise technologies.
